favourite.heading: Why Louisville can pull away

underdog.heading: Why SMU can keep it close
bullets: SMU is the better football team by 3.0 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-3.0 pts).
The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 -22.4 to p90 +22.6 for Louisville, so a projection of +1.6 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
